Amenities

  • 8 Thermal Pools

    Bathhouse Williamsburg features eight thermal pools: three hot pools (104°F), two cold plunges (45°F, 50°F), two neutral pools (98°F), and a Rooftop Pool (84°F). Rotate between the pools to reap the recovery benefits.

  • Event Sauna

    Join a complimentary Guided Sauna Session in our Event Sauna, where temperatures reach up to 175°F.

  • Rooftop Pool

    The Rooftop Pool is open for the winter season as long as weather permits. View all of the latest Rooftop news here.

  • Banya

    Heated by basalt stones in a furnace, the Banya runs between 185°F and 195°F.

  • Dry Sauna

    The Dry Sauna, often thought of as a Scandinavian sauna, runs between 175°F - 190°F.

  • Tropical Sauna

    Sweat it out in our Tropical Sauna. The temperature gets up to 185°F, and with the tropical-level humidity, feels like 200°F.

  • Steam Room

    Our Starlight Steam Room runs at 115°F with a replica of the night sky in the overhead lighting design.

  • Rooftop Pool Bar

    Enjoy cocktails, Prosecco on tap, local beers, and poolside snacks at our Rooftop Pool Bar. View menu.
